placeholders.verifier: Name of the organisation that asked for the evidence. Use common.verifier_fallback when it is unknown.
placeholders.document: Document type name, for example Passport.
placeholders.side: capture.side_front or capture.side_back, lower cased inside a sentence.
placeholders.types: Allowed file types, upper cased and joined with a comma and a space.
placeholders.size: Maximum file size, formatted as megabytes, for example 10 MB.
placeholders.place: Label of a reference place, for example Head office. Never coordinates.
placeholders.places: Labels of several reference places, joined with a comma and a space.
placeholders.destination: Masked email address or phone number returned when a code is sent, for example J*******@example.com.

strings.intro.title: Verify your identity
strings.intro.body: Follow the steps requested by {verifier}. Review each item before you send it.
strings.exit.title: Leave for now?
strings.exit.body: Evidence you already sent is kept. Unsent photos and files will be discarded. You can come back through the app that sent you here.
strings.exit.discard_body: You have not sent this document yet.
strings.documents.title: Documents requested
strings.documents.unavailable: Not available in this app. Contact {verifier}.
strings.documents.selfie_next: After your documents, you will take a selfie.
strings.documents.location_next: After your documents, you will share your location.
strings.documents.selfie_location_next: After your documents, you will take a selfie and share your location.
strings.documents.location_selfie_next: After your documents, you will share your location and take a selfie.
strings.documents.host_steps_next: After your documents, the app will guide you through the remaining steps.
strings.capture.instruction_camera: Place the {document} on a flat surface. Keep all four corners visible and avoid glare.
strings.capture.instruction_either: Take a photo or choose a saved file of the {side}.
strings.capture.instruction_upload: Choose a clear photo or scan of the {side}.
strings.capture.instruction_upload_pdf: Choose a clear photo, scan or PDF of the {side}.
strings.capture.also_saved_file: You also need to add a saved file of each side.
strings.capture.check_photo: Check that all four corners are visible, the text is sharp and there is no glare.
strings.review.title: Review before sending
strings.review.body: Check each photo and file before you send them.
strings.sending.sent_body: We are checking that everything arrived.
strings.receipt.title: Evidence received
strings.receipt.body: Your evidence will be reviewed by {verifier}. You can close this screen.
strings.receipt.host_steps: The app will guide you through the remaining steps.
strings.selfie.title: Take a selfie
strings.selfie.guidance: Face the camera in even light. Keep your whole face visible and remove anything covering it.
strings.selfie.tip_light: Find even light on your face.
strings.selfie.tip_glasses: Take off glasses if you can.
strings.selfie.review_body: Make sure your face is clear and fully visible before you send it.
strings.selfie.privacy: Your selfie will be sent to {verifier} for review.
strings.liveness.title: Follow the prompts
strings.liveness.body: You will be asked to make {total} simple movements. Keep your face inside the frame.
strings.liveness.position.center: Center your face in the frame
strings.liveness.position.one_face: Make sure only your face is in the frame
strings.liveness.gesture.turn_left: Slowly turn your head to your left, then back
strings.liveness.gesture.turn_right: Slowly turn your head to your right, then back
strings.liveness.gesture.nod: Nod: look down, then back up
strings.liveness.face_lost: We lost sight of your face. Look at the camera.
strings.liveness.timeout: Time ran out for this movement.
strings.liveness.expired: This step timed out. Start it again.
strings.video.consent: This step records a short video of your face. It is sent to {verifier} for review.
strings.location.title: Share your location
strings.location.why: {verifier} asks where you are right now. Your location is used only for this request.
strings.location.what_shared: We send your coordinates, how accurate they are and when they were taken.
strings.location.permission_prompt: Your device will ask for permission. Choose Allow.
strings.location.waiting_accuracy: Getting a more accurate reading. Stay where you are, near a window or outside if you can.
strings.location.found_body: Check it looks right, then send it.
strings.location.permission_denied: Location access is off. Turn it on in Settings, then try again.
strings.location.permission_denied_browser: Location access is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, then reload the page.
strings.location.unavailable: Location is not available on this device.
strings.location.timeout: We could not find your location in time. Try again.
strings.location.low_accuracy: Your location is not accurate enough yet. Move near a window or outside, then try again.
strings.location.mock_detected: An app or setting is changing your device location. Turn it off, then try again.
strings.location.stale: Your location reading is out of date. Try again to take a new one.
strings.location.ip_country_mismatch: Your internet connection seems to be in a different country from your location. Turn off any VPN or proxy, then try again.
strings.location.retries_exhausted: We could not get your location. Contact {verifier}.
strings.location.place.need_within_any: You need to be at one of these places: {places}.
strings.location.place.need_within_all: You need to be at each of these places: {places}.
strings.location.place.need_outside: You need to be away from {place}.
strings.location.place.need_outside_all: You need to be away from these places: {places}.
strings.location.place.need_outside_any: You need to be away from at least one of these places: {places}.
strings.location.place.not_matched_within: You do not seem to be at {place} yet. Move closer, then try again.
strings.location.place.not_matched_outside: You seem to be too close to {place}. Move away, then try again.
strings.location.place.not_precise: Your location is not precise enough to check this place. Move near a window or outside, then try again.
strings.location.place.rejected: Your location does not match the place requested by {verifier}. Try again from the right place.
strings.email.title: Confirm your email address
strings.email.body: {verifier} asks you to confirm an email address. We will send a short code to it.
strings.email.label: Email address
strings.phone.title: Confirm your phone number
strings.phone.body: {verifier} asks you to confirm a phone number. We will send a short code to it by text message.
strings.phone.label: Phone number
strings.phone.hint: Start with + and your country code, for example +44 7700 900123.
strings.phone.invalid: Enter the number in international format, starting with + and the country code.
strings.contact_code.title: Enter the code
strings.contact_code.body: We sent a code to {destination}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
strings.contact_code.label: Code
strings.contact_code.resend_in: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} seconds.
strings.contact_code.sends_remaining: You can ask for {count} more codes.
strings.questions.title: Answer a few questions

strings.rejection.location_stale.title: Location out of date
strings.rejection.location_mock.title: Location is being changed
strings.rejection.location_ip_country.title: Connection in another country
strings.rejection.location_reference.title: Location does not match

strings.rejection.gesture_mismatch.title: Movements did not match

strings.rejection.not_camera.title: Camera needed

strings.rejection.video_missing.title: Recording missing
strings.rejection.video_missing.message: The recording of this step did not arrive. Start the step again.
strings.rejection.video_too_long.title: Recording too long
strings.rejection.video_too_long.message: The recording was longer than allowed. Start the step again and follow the prompts without pausing.
strings.rejection.video_unreadable.title: Recording could not be read
strings.rejection.video_unreadable.message: We could not read the recording. Start the step again.
strings.rejection.email_not_configured.title: Email confirmation unavailable
strings.rejection.email_not_configured.message: Confirming an email address is not available for this request yet. Contact {verifier}.
strings.rejection.phone_not_configured.title: Phone confirmation unavailable
strings.rejection.phone_not_configured.message: Confirming a phone number is not available for this request yet. Contact {verifier}.

strings.rejection.code_resend_too_soon.message: A code was sent less than a minute ago. Wait a moment, then ask for a new code.
strings.rejection.code_send_limit.title: Too many codes sent
strings.rejection.code_send_limit.message: Too many codes were sent for this request. Try again in 24 hours.
strings.rejection.code_missing.title: No code to check

strings.rejection.code_invalid.title: Code not correct
strings.rejection.code_invalid.message: This code is not correct. Check it and enter it again.
strings.rejection.code_too_many_attempts.title: Too many wrong codes
strings.rejection.code_too_many_attempts.message: Too many wrong codes were entered. Ask for a new code.
